title: backend-coordination-v1
description: Machine-readable summary of the backend-owned coordination surface only. Home private API is H1-owned (infra-server/contracts/home-api-v1.md + .openapi.json). endpointHint carries the home protected base URL opaquely; installationId correlates backend homeId with H1 installation_id. Auth modes: explicit dev tokens (loopback-only) or hosted OIDC JWT verification (jose, static trusted JWKS or fixed trusted JWKS HTTPS URL). Public login metadata: GET /v1/auth/config (protocol account-auth-v1); verification: GET /v1/account. Full contract: docs/account-auth-v1.md.

dev.const: dev bearer tokens + fleet setup secret; loopback binds only

hosted.const: OIDC JWT access-tokens (signature/exp/issuer/audience/subject, asymmetric algorithms, static JWKS or fixed trusted JWKS HTTPS URL with caching/rotation/timeout, optional token_use); identity acct_<sha256(iss,sub)>; registration via account-bound one-time tickets, no fleet secret; public login metadata GET /v1/auth/config (account-auth-v1), verification GET /v1/account

homeId.const: backend coordination key ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9_-]{2,63}$; generated as home_<18 lowercase hex> when omitted

installationId.const: H1 installation identity (uuid), stored verbatim at register/heartbeat, returned on reads; uniqueness not enforced

endpointHint.const: home protected base URL, opaque, never fetched

protocolVersion.const: "home-api-v1" when the home speaks H1's contract

default: Backend ticketId/ticketSecret binds account<->home membership; never a device credential.
H1 invitation_id/invitation_secret enrolls a device at the home; never sent to the backend.
Backend me_home_* token authenticates the home to the backend only.
H1 device_id+device_secret / ht1_* session token authenticates a device to the home only.

setup.const: X-Me-Setup-Token: <setup-secret> (dev only; refused in hosted mode)

identityRule.const: Identity is derived server-side from the presented credential. accountId/userId fields in request bodies are rejected.

default: No chat/conversation/message/task/content endpoints or payload storage.
No home task scheduler or dispatch authority.
Hosted auth readiness only: OIDC verification implemented, no IdP provisioned.
Does not define the home private paired-device API (H1-owned).
Single-process JSON store; no production database concurrency claimed.
